posts.name: 29-mind-teen-boys-tate
posts.caption:
One in three US teen boys follow Andrew Tate at least a little, a new survey of 601 boys finds. But parents' "be big and tough" messages predicted traditional manhood views even more strongly 🧠

The catch: it is one snapshot in time, so it cannot show that following Tate causes these views.

Source: Scharrer, Ward, Volling (UMass Amherst, University of Michigan), “Following Manosphere Influencers and Endorsement of Traditional Masculinity Beliefs Among Adolescent Boys”, Psychology of Men & Masculinities, 2026.

#AndrewTate #parenting #teenagers #psychology #masculinity
